input.quote: Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
input.rationale: Section 17 contains post-termination obligations running only against us (return/destruction of Garman's Software, Documentation and Codes), and Sections 14, 16 and 18 contain nothing requiring Garman to return Sparkling's data or to assist with migration on exit. The source-code escrow/on-site source code in Section 16 is only a partial substitute — it covers Garman's code, not our converted business data (Section 4 confirms our data is loaded into Garman's system). With no data return or transition assistance anywhere in the agreement, the rule's fallback (90 days' assistance and export within 30 days) is not met, so we propose inserting a new Section 17(d) at the preferred position: up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable data return within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter.

ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (1) at Sparkling's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (2) within thirty (30) calendar days of such expiry or termination, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (3) thereafter delete Sparkling's data from its systems and certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a reciprocal exit provision: Section 17(b) already requires us to return or destroy Garman's materials, but nothing requires Garman to return our data or help us transition. Our playbook requires up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of our data in machine-readable form within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can work with 90 days of assistance if that is easier for Garman to resource.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 17(d) requiring Garman to provide transition assistance and return/delete Sparkling's data on termination.
